text.en: You can now generate and refine custom graphics using simple text prompts.

text.en: Google just launched a new tool called Google Pics that uses AI to help you create and edit images. You can use it to make social media posts or fix up illustrations without needing to be a pro. It’s built right into apps like Docs and Slides, so you don't have to switch tabs to get your work done. You can even team up with friends to edit the same image together.

text.en: Basic explainer
text.th: ผู้อธิบายขั้นพื้นฐาน

text.en: Google Pics — our image creation and editing tool from Google Workspace — is rolling out over the coming weeks to all Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers and most Workspace business customers.
text.th: Google Pics — our image creation and editing tool from Google Workspace — is rolling out over the coming weeks to all Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers and most Workspace business customers.

text.en: Built on our Nano Banana image generation and editing model, Pics gives you the control you need to create whatever you're imagining, whether you're designing a poster, producing social media posts, or editing digital illustrations. Google Pics will be both a standalone product and integrated into Workspace apps, starting with Slides, Docs, and Drive, so you’ll be able to edit images where you’re already working.
text.th: Built on our Nano Banana image generation and editing model, Pics gives you the control you need to create whatever you're imagining, whether you're designing a poster, producing social media posts, or editing digital illustrations. Google Pics will be both a standalone product and integrated into Workspace apps, starting with Slides, Docs, and Drive, so you’ll be able to edit images where you’re already working.

text.th: Precise control meets ease of use

text.en: Watch how to instantly create and refine custom graphics using the powerful editing controls in Google Pics.

text.en: Easily design and fine-tune eye-catching social media content and digital announcements using Google Pics.

text.en: Object segmentation: Pics lets you easily isolate an object and transform it without altering the rest of your image. You can input text comments on specific areas to request targeted changes and execute multiple edits at once.
text.th: Object segmentation: Pics lets you easily isolate an object and transform it without altering the rest of your image. You can input text comments on specific areas to request targeted changes and execute multiple edits at once.

text.en: In-image text editing and translation: Modify or translate text directly inside an image without disrupting the design or changing the font.

text.en: Collaborate with others: Share Pics creations with your friends and teammates, then collaborate to edit the same image.

text.en: Multiple generations: Pics generates several options from a single prompt, so you can choose your favorite from a variety of iterations.

text.en: Seamless integrations with Google Workspace
text.th: Seamless integrations with Google Workspace

text.en: Millions of users interact with billions of images across Workspace products every month. To make this experience even more seamless, we’re bringing Google Pics directly into the tools you already use. You shouldn’t have to jump between applications to create and share visuals. Now, you can harness powerful AI image generation and editing right where you are — no copying, pasting, or switching tabs required.
